product_metadata.title: Enesco Jim Shore Heartwood Creek Winter Wonderland Santa with Garland Figurine, 10.5", Multicolor
features: “Wrapped in Good Tidings” from the Jim Shore Heartwood Creek collection
Jim Shore’s unmistakable style combines a diverse color palette
Captures a Wonderland Santa in beautiful detail
description: Jim Shore’s hand-carved Heartwood Creek collectibles impart a sense of hope and nostalgia, embracing inspiring themes of family, tradition, spirituality, and patriotism. His Winter Wonderland collection features bright, beautiful colors and shimmery glitter accents. This vintage-style stone resin Santa wears a richly embroidered coat and poinsettia-evergreen garland, handcrafted and hand-painted in exquisite detail. An instant heirloom, this piece makes a striking centerpiece at 10. 5” tall. About Us: Enesco is committed to BRING JOY EVERY DAY. The premier global destination for high-quality giftware, and home décor, our prestigious family of brands includes: Department 56 Village, Gregg Gift, Foundations, Jim Shore Heartwood Creek, Disney Traditions by Jim Shore, Disney Showcase Collection, Disney by Britto, Designs by Lolita, Our Name Is Mud, and many more.
